description:
Today AMD launch their new RX590 - and its actually a pretty good value for money proposition with this Sapphire Nitro+ RX590 version hitting retail around £260 in the UK via Overclockers UK.

Dominic, our GPU EDITOR was taken ill just before launch and Leo helped to get this review done in a few quick days so we could give you all the juicy details.

Read the full review over on www.kiguru.net HERE: http://bit.ly/2Prs81D

Reference RX 590 Base Speed 1469MHz, Boost 1545MHz
Sapphire Nitro+ RX 590 Boost speed 1560MHz.
(Sapphire Nitro+ RX 580 Boost speed 1380MHz, memory 8000MHz)
2,304 Unified Shaders
Memory 8GB GDDR5
Memory Speed 2,100MHz, Effective 8,400MHz
Memory Interface 256-bit
Reference Memory Bandwidth 256GB/sec
Sapphire Memory Bandwidth 268.8GB/sec (by my calculation)
Up to 7.1 TFlops

Test system:
CPU: Intel Core i7-8700K Turbo 4.4GHz All Cores
Motherboard: Gigabyte Z370 Aorus Ultra Gaming
RAM: 16GB Aorus RGB DDR4-3200MHz
CPU cooler: Fractal Design Celsius S24
SSD: 1TB WD Black M.2 NVMe
Power Supply: Seasonic Prime Platinum 1300W

KitGuru uses a variety of equipment to produce content:
As of 27th April 2018:
Panasonic GH5 Cameras
Panasonic GH4 Cameras
Panasonic G7 Cameras
Various PC builds

Final output – colour grading/titling etc:
iMac Pro 18 Core/Vega 64/128GB
Adobe Premiere Pro CC (PC)
Davinci Resolve Studio 14/15 (Mac)
Final Cut Pro (Mac)
